subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should this issue be resolved by the scoped WebChat transcript-notice fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95154, or should maintainers require a broader restart-deferral/user-message durability design before closing it?
rationale: Current main is still missing the WebChat notice path, and repository policy treats persisted session recovery behavior as compatibility-sensitive; automation cannot choose the durable recovery contract for maintainers.

options.title: Land Scoped Notice Fallback
options.body: Resolve the linked PR conflicts and land the guarded transcript notice so WebChat users see an interruption message instead of a blank failed chat.

options.title: Require Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Hold the issue open for restart deferral or immediate inbound-message persistence if maintainers want to prevent the interrupted turn from becoming non-resumable in the first place.

options.title: Ask For Live WebChat Proof First
options.body: Keep the PR path but require a short Control UI restart/reconnect proof before accepting the user-visible behavior.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Notice Fallback
recommendation.body: Resolve the linked PR conflicts and land the guarded transcript notice so WebChat users see an interruption message instead of a blank failed chat.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits at the intersection of restart deferral, delivery mirrors, and session recovery history where steipete has merger and adjacent implementation history.
